markdown-it quadratic-time smartquotes on unmatched closing quotes. The renderer pins markdown-it with typographer set to false (MARKDOWN_IT_OPTIONS in render-policy-content), which leaves the smartquotes rule inactive, and it runs markdown-it only inside the network-disabled, time-bounded build on author content the intake already size-limits. The pinned 14.3.1 is part of the published render-policy identity (contracts/render-policy.jcs), so the upgrade is a render-policy revision, not a dependency bump. Revisit with the next render-policy revision, which moves markdown-it to 14.3.3 or later.
